title: Pay a Toll Notice for the Sydney Harbour Bridge or Tunnel
summary: This page explains how to pay for a Toll Notice for the Sydney Harbour Bridge or Tunnel online.
intro:
The Sydney Harbour Bridge (SHB) and Tunnel tolls are charged on the southbound journey.

If you've received a Toll Notice for travel on the SHB or Tunnel, you can pay for this online using your credit card or an electronic tag account.

If you've mislaid or lost the notice you are still able to pay online. You only need your vehicle's number plate and the state it's registered in to search for an unpaid toll trip.

Note: To avoid receiving the Toll Notice in the first place, open an E-toll account or set up a pass within 3 days (72 hours) of your unpaid journey, and pay the toll. Visit Travelling without an account or pass for more information.
what_you_need: Your vehicle's number plate and the state it is registered in
Your toll notice number (if you have it)

how_to_steps.text: Enter the vehicle's details or the toll notice number.
Follow the prompts to complete your transaction.

more_info.text: If you're making a payment using your E-Toll tag account and don't have sufficient funds, or if you provide incorrect details, you'll receive a further notice by mail.
If you're paying using your E-Toll tag account, your 'Toll Notice Administration' fee will be replaced with the 'Toll Notice Transfer' fee.
If you're not paying using an E-Toll tag account, a 'Toll Notice Administration' fee will be applied.
If you've received a toll notice from another operator other than Transport for NSW, please refer to the toll notice for payment options.
